title: Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A sequel set decades after Jujutsu Kaisen, in which an alien people, the Simurians, arrive on Earth seeking a home (to verify). Sorcerer siblings Yuka and Tsurugi Okkotsu and the Simurian Maru are caught between jujutsu society, the Japanese government and the newcomers as talks over coexistence break down (to verify). Story by Gege Akutami, art by Yuji Iwasaki.
life_message: It holds up the hard work of understanding strangers and keeping peace between peoples, even when force seems easier (to verify).
